name: 秘牙 ハルト🐰🐺
description:
ひよっこアニメーター　ひが はるとです！
絵を描きゲームをする狼人間です！ おててと動物と虫が大好きです。 
Language:JP/EN

works.body:
Hello! I am a fan of your work.
I really admire the atmosphere of your illustrations, your attention to detail, and your drawing ability to reveal the character's personality.

I would love to have you draw one of my characters. There is no situation specified, and a solid background is fine.
I would like you to draw a character named "Tokieda Mangetsu," a character created by myself for TRPG and DX3rd.
I would be happy if you could check the following URL for materials.

Illustration
https://twitter.com/orionza_trpg/status/1600285900831096832?s=61&t=5S1qLkTBu8kiYEowOQ879A
https://twitter.com/orionza_trpg/status/1614279749869916160?s=61&t=5S1qLkTBu8kiYEowOQ879A
Character sheet
https://yutorize.2-d.jp/ytsheet/dx3rd/?id=RDUQjO
There is no back drawing, so you may draw freely.

To capture the character's setting, she is a type of character known as an awakening frame in Double Cross, and she awakens to her special abilities during the story.
Her ability allows her to fight by changing her arms like black coral reefs, liquefy her legs and manipulate them at will, and move at high speed.
She is a strong girl with a strong personality, but at her core she is kind and sometimes smiles.

We will continue to support you, Hibiki Hurt.
I eagerly await your work!
